signed_rows.behavior: every routing rule in bifrost.hcl has a priority above 3, the passthrough rule has the lowest priority among them, and no two share one
signed_rows.fails_when: a rule's priority is 3 or below, the passthrough is not first among the router rules, or two rules share a priority

signed_rows.behavior: the repo gates and the CLI test suite pass
signed_rows.fails_when: just pre_commit or uv run --directory cli pytest exits non-zero
signed_rows.command: just pre_commit && uv run --directory cli pytest

signed_rows.behavior: after the operator applies, Bifrost boots and stays healthy, the Claude Code haiku/sonnet/opus/fable rules still route, and scripts/bifrost_smoke.py passes with BIFROST_ROUTER_VK set
signed_rows.fails_when: Bifrost fails to boot, a Claude Code alias no longer reaches its Ollama model, or the smoke script fails
